violated_contract: A unit refused for a reason that lasts until an owner's plan changes (exhausted allowance or usage budget) must not be re-delivered at a transient retry cadence through a queue it shares with other owners. On 2026-11-12 the provider-STT stage re-checked refused owners every 60 seconds, each re-check minting a new Cloud Task, so about 83 over-allowance owners held most of the provider-stt queue's 10 dispatches per second while 393,949 entitled units waited up to a week.
canonical_prevention: Classify the denial reason at every spend gate and park durable denials for the shared hold window (allowance_hold_retry_seconds), keeping the short retry only for transient denials. Test both the durable and the transient reason at each gate that defers.
